items.scene: The Portland Old Port waterfront on Casco Bay with the Portland Observatory tower on the hill, working lobster boats and a lighthouse on the point.

items.label: Burlington, VT
items.scene: Burlington's waterfront on Lake Champlain with a church steeple on the hill, sailboats and the Adirondack Mountains rising across the water.
